task_completion.description: Open the GMAT application and load the baseline script from the specified path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: GMAT GUI is visible with the file 'lunar_baseline.script' loaded in the resources tree or script editor.

task_completion.description: Modify the script or mission sequence to propagate for at least 3 days starting March 13, 2025.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Epoch' field in the Spacecraft or 'StopCondition' in the Propagate command shows a duration of at least 3 days (259200 seconds) starting from 13 Mar 2025.

task_completion.description: Verify the creation of the EclipseReport.txt file in the specified output directory.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A file browser or text editor shows 'EclipseReport.txt' inside the '~/GMAT_output/' folder containing Umbra duration data.

task_completion.description: Create the eclipse_analysis.json file with the correct key and the maximum umbra duration value.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor shows 'eclipse_analysis.json' with the key 'max_umbra_duration_seconds' and a numerical value (expected to be > 3500).

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the GMAT GUI rather than just using terminal commands to create files.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the GMAT application window active, navigating menus, or clicking the 'Run' icon.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply echo the answer into the JSON without running the simulation.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent is seen opening the EclipseReport.txt generated by GMAT to find the duration value before writing the JSON.

integrity.description: The agent ensured both Earth and Luna were used as occulting bodies as per the task.
